posts.name: Saparo
posts.tagline: Muse for shopping with deals stacks
posts.description: Saparo is a personal shopping agent that stacks every deal. Tell it what you want, and it searches U.S. stores for the same item in your size, combining promo codes, cash back, and eligible card offers that work together. It ranks options by estimated total cost, including shipping and tax, so you skip the legwork. With your approval, Saparo applies selected offers and gets checkout ready. You review the order and make the final payment yourself.

posts.name: Tripmojo
posts.tagline: Agentic travel app that helps plan, book and run your trip
posts.description: Tripmojo syncs your booking emails into one shared trip, then Mojo, your AI travel agent, helps run it. Plan in a group chat where Mojo answers, runs polls and finds places. On travel day Mojo tries to check you in, saves your boarding pass, flags delays and gate changes, and tells you when to leave. On the trip it keeps today's plan current and splits expenses. Free on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Docker
posts.tagline: Built to run on trust, for the agentic era
posts.description: Docker is evolving for the agentic era. Containers isolate workloads, but agents aren't workloads: they're actors that need isolation, security and governance. The new Docker brings a trusted supply chain for agents to build from, a trusted runtime to isolate them (Docker Sandboxes), and governance for agents across every team (Docker AI Governance), alongside a redesigned brand and Moby whale.

posts.name: Bookella
posts.tagline: A reading tracker that helps you read more
posts.description: Bookella is a reading tracker and home library for iPhone, iPad and Android. Add books in seconds: search 122 million titles in 28 languages, pick from reading lists, scan a whole shelf of barcodes at once, or let AI pick your next book. Set yearly and daily reading goals, time your sessions, and track your reading pace. Keep notes and quotes, and see when and how much you read. You can also import from Goodreads, StoryGraph or CSV. No ads.

posts.name: Currents
posts.tagline: Currents for Claude & Codex to see all your tests
posts.description: Currents records every Playwright test run in CI. Now Claude and Codex can read it. Connect from the Claude or ChatGPT/Codex plugin directory, sign in, and ask why CI failed. Your agent gets the failure, its history and the trace. Automatically.

posts.name: Tamekoshi
posts.tagline: A Tamagotchi-style AI companion that does real work
posts.description: Tame is an AI companion that does real work from the top of your screen: one message with three asks becomes three subagents in parallel, it runs tasks on its own computer, answers clients on WhatsApp and Telegram and writes meeting notes speaker by speaker. Nothing acts without your OK. Think Tamagotchi, all grown up. Free beta; a mobile app, multiplayer and open source are on the roadmap.

posts.name: Direct by Instagram
posts.tagline: Instagram DMs, without the feed or Instagram account
posts.description: Direct is Meta's new standalone messaging app from Instagram. Chat with friends without opening the Instagram feed, Reels, or Stories. Sign in with Instagram to sync your existing conversations, or join using just an email address or phone number. Make chats more personal with drawings, custom stickers, voice effects, Notes, and themes. Currently testing on iOS and Android in Türkiye and Thailand, with additional restrictions for users without Instagram accounts.

posts.name: tensorViz
posts.tagline: Let your coding agent see inside your PyTorch model
posts.description: Coding agents can read your PyTorch code, but they never see what actually flows through the model. tensorViz runs one real forward pass and turns it into an interactive graph with every module and tensor shape. Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can search that graph and read the measured shapes, so they fix model code from evidence instead of guesses. Or skip the install: the Model Explorer has graphs of 560+ models from recent papers to browse and discuss. Free and open source (MIT).

posts.name: Volcano
posts.tagline: The self-healing agent cloud by Kong
posts.description: Volcano is one place to build, host and run agents and apps. Deploy from the coding agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi) or the AI Builder. You get year-long durable functions, human-in-the-loop approvals, resumable sandboxes, distributed locks, branchable Postgres, auth, storage, realtime, and backend and Next.js hosting. LavaFlow finds and fixes bugs on its own, so your apps and agents keep getting better over time.

posts.name: MakePixel
posts.tagline: Pixel art editor for game sprites, tilesets and maps
posts.description: MakePixel is a pixel art editor for game assets that runs in your browser, iPad included. Animate sprites with the keys you know from Aseprite, draw a few tiles to get a full autotile set, paint levels, and export to Godot, Unity or Tiled. Free to start.

posts.name: Rox
posts.tagline: Your AI companion for living with chronic illness
posts.description: Rox is an AI health companion for people living with chronic illness, including POTS, fibromyalgia, ME/CFS, MS, and long COVID. Track symptoms and medications, connect wearable health data, spot patterns, and prepare for doctor appointments in one place. Rox remembers your health context over time, so you can spend less energy explaining your story and more time managing everyday life.

posts.name: Kuc-kuc
posts.tagline: A knock on the door when dangerous weather comes
posts.description: When dangerous weather is forecast, Kuc-kuc phones an older person who lives alone and asks if they are okay. No answer, or “I’m not well”? It phones a neighbour to go and knock. The family sees every step. Works on a landline. Runs on Cloud Run.

posts.name: aiteam.space
posts.tagline: An AI team where every agent has its own computer
posts.description: aiteam.space gives each AI teammate, a Son, its own computer. It runs real Claude Code sessions on your own subscription, builds and deploys websites, makes videos, joins your Google Meet calls and handles daily posts. You manage the whole team on a visual org chart, from Claude, ChatGPT, Telegram or Discord. Your first Son is free forever.

posts.name: Compass OS
posts.tagline: Your career, ready before you need it
posts.description: Compass OS is your career's chief of staff, built for senior leaders. It finds Director, VP and Head-of roles across job boards and 90+ hiring systems, scores each against your experience, and tailors your resume with only what's true: every claim is checked against your profile. Compass Apply fills applications in Chrome; you press submit. Between searches it keeps your resume and LinkedIn current and helps you practice interviews. Free plan, no card.

posts.name: ThreadLore
posts.tagline: Turn fabric photos into editable loom drafts
posts.description: When a textile’s weaving instructions are lost, a photograph still holds clues. ThreadLore helps handweavers inspect a fabric photo, check a suggested weave against the yarn crossings, and turn the pattern they approve into a printable loom card or WIF file.

posts.name: HelpCard
posts.tagline: a free emergency QR card
posts.description: Make a free emergency card with a QR code: blood group, allergies, medicines and who to call. Nothing is stored. Fun themes for kids.

posts.name: AI Gateway
posts.tagline: Manage your company's AI from one place
posts.description: AI Gateway puts your self-hosted models and providers like OpenAI, Groq and Together behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It runs on your own servers. Your GPUs take the traffic first, vendors step in when needed, and you decide who uses what.

posts.name: Samiksa
posts.tagline: Understand research, test it yourself, publish your own
posts.description: Samiksa is an AI co-researcher. Give it a paper, blog post or any document, and it turns it into an interactive document shaped by your questions, not by how it was written. Ask what you want to know and the page reshapes around the answer, each claim traced to its source. Then launch a sandbox experiment: rerun what the research shared, or test your own hypothesis as your co-researcher helps with code and data. Your own work goes from rough idea to research you can publish. Join the waitlist.

posts.name: Nova by Vybe
posts.tagline: Nova audits your website free, then fixes what it finds
posts.description: Vybe's Nova is a free AI agent that audits your website on SEO, speed, conversion, accessibility, and security, then tells you what to fix first. You get a full report in minutes, with before/after mockups and competitor benchmarks. Want the fixes actually done? Nova runs on Vybe, so you can hand her the keys and let her apply the recommendations herself.

posts.name: Stormi
posts.tagline: An AI team on your iPhone that does real work
posts.description: Stormi gives you a team of AI agents on your iPhone. Each bot has a name, one job, and its own model. They keep working on our server when your phone is off, and stop to ask before they send, pay, or delete anything. 89 plugins, hundreds of models.

posts.name: Conversaflex
posts.tagline: AI speaking practice for multilingual teams
posts.description: AI speaking practice for multilingual teams in French, English and Spanish. Employees practise real work situations (client calls, meetings, safety briefings) with Madame AI and get feedback on every sound they say. HR gets CEFR placement from A1 to C2, a progress dashboard, and participation records for reporting, including Quebec's Bill 96. Used by teams at GSK and Canam. Hosted in Canada, with pronunciation scoring on Google Cloud Run.

posts.name: Dozy
posts.tagline: Turns your sleep data into one thing to do today
posts.description: Tired and not sure what to do about it? Dozy reads your sleep from Apple Health, works out how much you need and what you owe, and gives you one action a day: a short nap or the right bedtime. On iPhone and Apple Watch, with Oura and Garmin. Free.

posts.name: AI Call
posts.tagline: An AI that answers and makes your business calls
posts.description: AI Call answers your business line and makes outbound calls for you. The AI talks with callers, takes down what they need, records it and puts them through to your staff when needed. No base fee: $5/month per number, $0.30 per connected minute.

posts.name: Groundwork
posts.tagline: Claude Code plans that re-runs never overwrite
posts.description: A Claude Code skill that scaffolds a plan folder: research, design, plan, tracking, and an HTML board. Re-runs only rewrite the blocks it generated, checked by a hash. Your own text stays as you wrote it. Free, Apache-2.0.

posts.name: Memanto Cloud
posts.tagline: A companion memory for agents to improve as you work
posts.description: A companion memory agent that lets your agents focus and improve while you keep ownership of everything they learn. Now hosted for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and 31 more: sign in once, no Docker, no API key.

posts.name: tripps
posts.tagline: Plan a group trip with one link, no account needed
posts.description: tripps puts everyone’s flights, trains, stays and plans on one day-by-day itinerary. Send the group one link: friends open it in the browser and edit it, no account or app. Forward a booking email, screenshot or PDF and Smart import adds it on the right day. Nights with nowhere to stay and journeys nobody has booked show on their day. Works offline, and Claude or ChatGPT can plan a tripp for you. Planning is free; tripps Pro adds polls, history and calendars.

posts.name: Baby's Day In
posts.tagline: Turn two phones into a baby monitor
posts.description: Not another baby cam. An AI baby monitor that works on any spare phone: it hears the cry, tells you, and starts the lullaby itself. No hardware to buy. Free on iPhone and Android.

posts.name: Bimdrop
posts.tagline: BIM file sharing. Simple and fast
posts.description: Open and share BIM and CAD files in the browser: Revit (RVT), IFC, STEP, IGES, Rhino (3DM), Tekla (DB1, DSTV NC1), DXF, BTLX, glTF/GLB, OBJ, FBX, DAE, STL, 3MF, USDZ and 70 file types in total. Share via link or embed an interactive 3D viewer. No sign-up needed to try it. Free — 10 files per month.

posts.name: Same Moon
posts.tagline: Free bedtime stories for children who had to leave home
posts.description: Gentle bedtime stories in English, Arabic and Spanish for refugee and displaced children, read aloud and built for cheap phones: tiny first load, works offline, no sign-up, no tracking. A person approves every story and every voice before a child hears it.

posts.name: Vatsalya Circle
posts.tagline: Family elder care: check-ins, missed alerts, SOS, scam help
posts.description: A free app for families looking after ageing parents. Medicine and daily check-ins ring like an alarm, the family hears only when one is missed, siblings take turns, SOS alerts everyone, and Safety Check helps elders with scam calls. English, Hindi, Bengali, Kannada.

posts.name: Fack’d
posts.tagline: Fact checks right on YouTube as it plays, with sources
posts.description: Open Fack’d beside a YouTube interview or debate to see which claims hold up as you watch. Each check pairs the speaker’s words with a timestamp, a rating, and sources you can read. Watch previously checked videos for free, or sign in for 10 free checks of your own.

posts.name: Interview Coach
posts.tagline: Practice job interviews out loud
posts.description: Practice mock job interviews interactively in a compatible desktop Chrome. Choose a role, provide the job description, and interview style, answer aloud, and get follow-up questions and feedback based on what you said. Practice as often as you like at launch. Speech is processed on your device, and Interview Coach saves no audio or video recordings. Sign in to view and save your coaching report and text transcript.

posts.name: Scam Link Check
posts.tagline: Paste a suspicious text or link, get a plain-English verdict
posts.description: Scam Link Check helps older relatives and anyone who isn't tech-savvy decide if a text or link is safe to tap. Paste a link or the whole message: it finds every web address, checks each with Google Web Risk, follows short links to see where they really go, and flags scam signs like brand look-alike names, brand-new domains, raw IP addresses and missing https. You get Dangerous / Suspicious / No known risk in plain words, plus what to do next. English & Chinese. Free, no sign-up, nothing stored.

posts.name: EarthSort
posts.tagline: Ask how to recycle anything and get your city's answer
posts.description: Recycling rules change at every city line, so the same cup is recycling at home and trash at work. Most sites only give generic guidance that's often wrong for your city. Ask EarthSort gives you your city's answer: type any item or upload a photo at earthsort.com/ask. No app needed. Local rules for 750+ US cities, with more added every day. Want it on the go? The free EarthSort app does the same with your camera.

posts.name: Inkrail
posts.tagline: A cozy, nostalgic typewriter experience built for deep work.
posts.description: Inkrail brings the charm of a vintage typewriter to your Mac (Windows support coming soon!). Enjoy textured paper, warm desk lamps, customizable aesthetics, and satisfying typing sounds. Switch to Focus Mode for distraction-free writing. Native, free, open-source, and local-first.

posts.name: NetSieve
posts.tagline: Block ads, trackers and scam sites in every app on your Mac
posts.description: NetSieve blocks ads, trackers and known scam sites for every app on your Mac, not just your browser. See which apps go online, which companies they reach and which countries your data ends up in. Your history stays on your Mac. Pay once, no subscription.

posts.name: Telo
posts.tagline: Apple Health in ChatGPT and Claude, in any country
posts.description: Telo is an iPhone app that sends your Apple Health history to the AI you already use. Connect once, then ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok or Cursor about your sleep, training and recovery. Every answer shows the records it read. The Apple Health connections built into ChatGPT and Claude are US-only, and Claude's needs a paid plan. Telo works in any country and on Claude's free plan. Your last 7 days are free. Pro is $49 a year for your full history.

posts.name: tinytldr
posts.tagline: Templates for your agents
posts.description: Design a template once in your browser. Claude or ChatGPT then fills it over MCP from any source (dashboards, articles, release notes) and exports a polished image, carousel or video. Pair it with Slack for a review flow. Open source, MIT.

posts.name: DMARC Pulse
posts.tagline: Find out who's sending email as your domain
posts.description: Gmail and Yahoo now push email that fails SPF, DKIM or DMARC to spam, or reject it. Your DMARC reports show exactly who sends as your domain, but they arrive as daily XML nobody reads. DMARC Pulse reads them for you: every sender matched by name, spoofers flagged, plain-language fixes, email alerts when something breaks, and a guided path from p=none to quarantine. Free for 1 domain, plus 16 free checkers with no signup.

posts.name: Veryfi Thinking Mode
posts.tagline: AI agents review and correct receipt and invoice data.
posts.description: Thinking Mode is Veryfi's agentic data extraction. Add the thinking parameter to a document request, and AI agents review the extraction, catch mistakes and correct them before the results come back. It currently works with receipts and invoices.

posts.name: Zethos
posts.tagline: The ledger you and your AI work from
posts.description: Zethos reads your email, Slack, calendar, meetings and more to track what you've promised others and what they've promised you, then closes each one automatically when it's done. Read-only on your accounts. Available on Mac and iOS, and readable and editable by any MCP-connected AI.

posts.name: UndoGuard
posts.tagline: The Ctrl+Z button for autonomous AI agents
posts.description: Giving AI agents write access to production is risky—one bad DELETE or PUT can wipe customer data. UndoGuard is a "Ctrl+Z" rollback proxy & MCP server that sits between your agents and APIs. It automatically snapshots and AES-256 encrypts state before every mutating call, letting you revert single mistakes or entire agent sessions in 1 click. Works with Claude, Cursor, LangChain, n8n, or any REST API. Try the live sandbox free (1,000 actions/mo).

posts.name: LOMI
posts.tagline: Run AI models locally on your Android device
posts.description: Download and run GGUF AI models directly on your Android device. Chat offline with local AI while keeping your conversations on your device.

posts.name: Andromon
posts.tagline: Your Android phone, on your computer. Free.
posts.description: Andromon is a free desktop app for managing your Android phone from Windows, macOS or Linux, over USB or Wi-Fi. Mirror and control the screen, text from your keyboard, see calls and notifications, move photos, files and music, back up everything in one click, and remove bloatware safely. Developer tools too: shell, logcat, test automation and an API inspector. Plus a phone companion app and a web version. No root, no account, no cloud, no ads.

posts.name: InteraOne
posts.tagline: Open-source Intercom & Zendesk alternative with AI agents
posts.description: InteraOne is the open-source, agentic alternative to Intercom & Zendesk. AI and human agents in one inbox, with one-click setup and deployment, self-hosted or cloud.

posts.name: Storiara
posts.tagline: AI producers that find real savings in your film budget
posts.description: Upload a script and Storiara builds the breakdown, stripboard, budget and call sheets. New: the Producer Room. An AI 1st AD, line producer, locations manager and casting lead read your schedule and budget and look for savings. Each idea is priced with your own rates before you see it, and only the ones that hold up reach you. Also new: sides go out with the call sheet, and each actor gets only their scenes.

posts.name: Nexuro AI
posts.tagline: Build AI chatbots from your own content in minutes
posts.description: Nexuro AI helps you turn your PDFs, documents, and website content into intelligent AI chatbots in minutes. Train personalized AI assistants on your own data, embed them on any website, and let them answer customer questions 24/7. No complex setup, no AI development expertise required — just your data, your AI.

posts.name: Badya
posts.tagline: Learn languages from real content with an agentic AI tutor
posts.description: Stop tapping matching cards. Start speaking. Badya turns any YouTube video or article into a lesson, then has you practice with an AI tutor: voice conversations, real-life role-plays, and spaced-repetition flashcards that quiz you out loud. Now on Android.

posts.name: DWaste
posts.tagline: Eliminate recycling contamination with low-power Edge AI
posts.description: DWaste is an AI-powered app that helps users sort waste correctly and earn rewards for proper recycling.

posts.name: Mailpipe
posts.tagline: Draft Apple Mail replies with your local AI agent CLI
posts.description: Mailpipe drafts Apple Mail replies using your existing AI agent CLI, including Codex and Claude Code. Open the Mailpipe panel from Mail’s reply or forward toolbar to review, generate, or regenerate a draft, then copy and paste it into Mail to send. Menu-bar review is also available. Attachments aren’t passed to the agent; drafts stay on your Mac. Model processing and costs depend on your agent’s configuration.

posts.name: FFMPA Kids News
posts.tagline: Calm, fact-checked news for kids 5 to 15
posts.description: A calm morning and evening news edition for kids 5 to 15, at three reading levels and fact checked before it goes out. Tap words to learn them, follow one Big Story all week, then the edition ends. No ads, no links out, no chat. Free for families and schools.

posts.name: Salus
posts.tagline: Discover benefits and public support in the Czech Republic
posts.description: Find Czech benefits, allowances and public support in four languages. Explore programs, answer optional questions and follow official application links. Free to use, with no account needed. Informational guidance, not a legal eligibility decision.

posts.name: Thruddle
posts.tagline: Discover events in UK pubs: live music, quizzes and more
posts.description: Thruddle is the easiest way to discover great pubs near you across the UK. See live music, quiz nights, and pub events near you in a single tap. Recurring events are tagged "Weekly" or "Monthly" so you know what's a one-off and what's a regular. Filter by what you actually care about: real ale, beer gardens, dog-friendly, pool tables, live sports, family-friendly, WiFi and more. Browse pubs near you on a map or as a list, with photos and accessibility info. Opening hours, a clear "Open now"...

posts.name: pickfit
posts.tagline: Every tool tested in a sandbox before it's recommended
posts.description: pickfit is a free software advisor for people and their AI agents. Before it recommends a tool, it installs it in a fresh sandbox, checks the features work and replays the steps offline. Then you get the steps that actually worked. No ads, no referral links.

posts.name: Megumi Planner
posts.tagline: Grow a garden together, and a community grows with it
posts.description: Some of the best moments in a neighborhood happen in a garden: kids picking their first fig, neighbors swapping seedlings, strangers becoming friends over a shared harvest. Megumi Planner helps people dream up that place together. Draw your garden or food forest on a photo of your land, watch it grow over the years, and share it with a link so everyone can see the dream and join in. Because a garden planned together becomes a place where everyone belongs. Free in beta. 🌱

posts.name: Binge Boss - Streaming Saver
posts.tagline: Watch it all. Pay for less.
posts.description: Binge Boss saves money by automatic planning of our streaming service, providing the optimal rotation. It schedules the services by when to binge, reminds you when to renew and when to cancel. You'll never pay for service nobody is watching again. Import your existing Library. Share our Library with friends and family and plan together. Binge Boss gathers every show from your household's lists into one plan. Available on Web, IOS, and Android with full sync between platforms.

posts.name: LiveClass
posts.tagline: Teach live, host webinars & stream—all in one
posts.description: LiveClass makes online teaching, training, and webinars more interactive. Run live sessions with collaborative whiteboards, breakout rooms, polls, Q&A, recording, and live streaming—all in your browser. Unlike ordinary meeting tools, LiveClass verifies attendance with server-recorded seat time and randomized presence checks. AI Agenda helps you plan sessions faster. Start free, no credit card required.

posts.name: Anya
posts.tagline: A personal AI agent. Send a message, get finished work back.
posts.description: Anya is a personal AI agent on WhatsApp and iMessage, made by IMAI. Send a message, get finished work back. Research a person or company before a meeting, find potential buyers, or work through a complex forecast. For fast, affordable answers, there's Instinct. For complex work, there's Anya: deeper thinking, less rework. The first 500 new Product Hunt users get $50 in free credits when they sign up through imai.studio/anya.

posts.name: Zyvolab 3D
posts.tagline: Turn 3D models into interactive web & AR product viewers
posts.description: ZyvoLab helps brands create, host and embed interactive 3D product models on their websites.

posts.name: Quarter: Block Puzzle Loops
posts.tagline: Close loops, clear the board, roll a whole new look
posts.description: Quarter is a calm puzzle about connecting paths. Drag corners, straights and crossings onto a 5x5 board and close loops to pop them. Fill the COMEBACK bar and the whole board comes back in a brand new finish: plush fur, chrome, neon, lava and 12 more, all drawn live. Play endless Classic runs or the Daily puzzle, the same board for everyone. No account, no timers, no energy. Works offline. Made by Haplo, a one-person indie studio.

posts.name: Quarter: Block Puzzle Loops
posts.tagline: Close loops, clear the board, roll a whole new look
posts.description: Quarter is a calm puzzle about connecting paths. Drag corners, straights and crossings onto a 5x5 board and close loops to pop them. Fill the COMEBACK bar and the whole board comes back in a brand new finish: plush fur, chrome, neon, lava and 12 more, all drawn live. Play endless Classic runs or the Daily puzzle, the same board for everyone. No account, no timers, no energy. Works offline. Made by Haplo, a one-person indie studio.

posts.name: Buzzmark
posts.tagline: Automated social media in your own voice
posts.description: Create a buzz around your brand. Buzzmark is a ghostwriter that writes, plans and schedules your social media in your own voice. Buzz keeps learning that voice from what you publish and every edit you make, and turns the edits you repeat into rules. Every draft is scored 0 to 100 against your voice before you see it. Buzz drafts your week and posts at your audience's best times on 9 platforms. Ask from Claude or ChatGPT over MCP, or use the CLI and API. Agencies get a white-label client portal.

posts.name: RCM Kit
posts.tagline: AI agents for healthcare revenue cycle teams
posts.description: RCM Kit is the AI foundation SNF billing runs on. It connects to billing systems, payers and banks, keeps each customer’s data isolated, and runs agents that post payments, chase A/R and rebill Medicaid, with staff approving every step. Live and growing.

posts.name: Wana Labs
posts.tagline: Build a course in minutes, see who actually learned it 🎓
posts.description: Type one sentence, get a full course in minutes: cited lessons, practice and tests. Then see who finished, where people get stuck, which questions they get wrong, and who needs help. Certificates, company portals and SCORM export included.

posts.name: SocialGTM
posts.tagline: The Swiss Army knife for go-to-market on social
posts.description: SocialGTM runs your go-to-market on social. It builds a 30-day growth roadmap for Reddit and X, writes your posts and lets you schedule them, and finds people asking for a tool like yours on X, Reddit, HN, Bluesky, and LinkedIn, with replies in your voice. It also tracks brand and competitor mentions, SEO threads, and every lead, and has an MCP server. You approve everything and press Post yourself on X, Reddit, LinkedIn, and HN. Plans start at $9 a month.

posts.name: TurkishFluent
posts.tagline: Structured Turkish course with native dialogues, A1 to B2
posts.description: Expats in Türkiye learn vocabulary and still freeze in a real conversation. TurkishFluent fixes that: every lesson explains the grammar, then drills it with dialogues recorded by native speakers at two speeds, AI pronunciation scoring and an AI tutor that corrects you. 50+ lessons from A1 to B2, written by a Turkish teacher in Istanbul.

posts.name: Livion
posts.tagline: Find a home that likes you back
posts.description: Find a new place to call home, your people, a roommate or a tenant, without the endless hunting. Tell Livion once what you need and how you want to live. It shows you who and what fits, and why. When both sides say yes, you chat, plan a viewing and decide for yourselves. When you book, your first month's rent is held safely until 48 hours after move-in. Less hunting. More living.

posts.name: Shhots AI for iOS
posts.tagline: Turn one product photo into photos and video ads on iPhone
posts.description: Turn a product photo on your iPhone into studio photos, creator-style UGC, cinematic videos and podcast ads. For online sellers and brand marketers creating campaign assets without organizing a shoot. Choose from 47 photo styles, make UGC in 12 languages, or generate 10–30 second product videos. Pick your photo, choose a look, and create in the app. Try it today!

posts.name: Rho Incorporation
posts.tagline: Incorporate your LLC or Delaware C-corp today
posts.description: Form an LLC in any state or a Delaware C-corp and open your Rho business account in the same flow, in about 10 minutes. State filing, a first-year registered agent and your EIN (SS-4) application are included. Deposit $10K within 90 days and your incorporation fee is credited back to Rho Rewards. Standardized formation documents; Rho is not a law firm. Rho is a fintech company, not a bank. Terms apply.

posts.name: WASD Engine
posts.tagline: Open-source harness that makes AI better at game dev
posts.description: WASD Engine is an open-source app that makes Claude or any agent much better at making games. All the tools you need to build games, tuned for agents. Build, play-test, publish, and host multiplayer.

posts.name: Hot Takes Studio
posts.tagline: PR, post-risk mitigation & reputation management
posts.description: PR support, post-risk mitigation and reputation management in one place. Review drafts and past posts, get client approval, monitor audience response and plan your next move. For social media managers, businesses and creators.

posts.name: Best Electrician Jobs
posts.tagline: Hire electricians from Claude or ChatGPT
posts.description: A job board for electricians and low-voltage techs, run by one person for two years. 6,000+ open jobs and 35,000+ journeyman résumés. Employers can now connect Claude or ChatGPT to check applicants, read résumés, draft jobs and pause postings.

posts.name: lightsout
posts.tagline: lightsout – Quit All Apps at Once on macOS, Linux & Windows
posts.description: 🌙 Quit all applications with one terminal command. Contribute to Abhisheksinha1506/lightsout development by creating an account on GitHub.

posts.name: RBTERP
posts.tagline: All-in-One ERP, Accounting & Business Management Software
posts.description: RBTERP is a powerful all-in-one ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) and business management software designed to simplify and automate business operations. Manage your accounting, finance, inventory, sales, purchases, customer relationships, HR, payroll, manufacturing, and business reporting from one integrated platform.

posts.name: greatai Review
posts.tagline: Free AI + human code review for open source & nonprofits
posts.description: Watch an AI team review your repo, live. Paste a public GitHub repo: quick AI scan in a minute; maintainers then get a full review by an Operum AI agent team on a live board, plus an optional credited human expert. Free for OSS and nonprofits. On Cloud Run.

posts.name: ember film launch
posts.tagline: The human way to find film.
posts.description: ember was built out of frustration by people who love film. Endless scrolling through Netflix always came out with the same result - usually a good film, but one that didn't quite hit the mark. We believed there had to be a better way. ember helps you find film in a more human way. What do you FEEL like watching? We believe this is how real people actually talk about film. It's a decision based on emotion and mood. What does the you of today, right now, feel like? ember answers that for you.

posts.name: Mars
posts.tagline: Your Mac. Two local engines. One calm place to scan.
posts.description: A free, open-source native macOS companion for ClamAV and optional YARA-X. Guided setup, honest reports, no account, no backend, no telemetry. On-demand scanning, not real-time protection. Never deletes or quarantines files.

posts.name: Free GBP Audit Simulator
posts.tagline: Free Google listing analysis in 60 seconds
posts.description: Free Google listing analysis in 60 seconds. No sign-up, no credit card. Find out what is holding back your local visibility right now.

posts.name: Pantry
posts.tagline: Keep your computer safe, for you and your agents
posts.description: Pantry is a free, open-source scanner for macOS, Linux and Windows. It finds the vulnerabilities, malware and risky agent configs actually on your machine, fixes what it safely can, and tells you how to fix the rest. No AI, no telemetry.

posts.name: Elixiary
posts.tagline: AI cocktail recipes from the bottles you already own
posts.description: Tell Elixiary what's in your bar and it shows what you can make tonight: over 1,000 checked cocktail and mocktail recipes plus an AI drink generator.

posts.name: TaskBaddie
posts.tagline: A to-do list that sorts your tasks and times your focus
posts.description: TaskBaddie helps you decide what to do first, then actually do it. Drop tasks into four boxes (Do First, Schedule, Delegate, Drop It) so priorities are clear at a glance. Pick one, start a 25, 50 or 75-minute sand timer with focus music, and get confetti and a streak when you clear a box. Built for students and working professionals. Free, works in your browser with no signup, and syncs across phone and laptop when you sign in. Pro adds recurring tasks and email reminders.

posts.name: Tierback
posts.tagline: Stop overpaying fees on B2B card sales
posts.description: Businesses that take corporate cards pay close to 3% on sales that could cost less. The lower rate depends on Level 3 data: line items, tax and product descriptions. Since April 2026, Visa also checks whether that data is accurate, and generic items like "Services" lose the rate with no error at checkout. Tierback checks and fixes that data before it reaches Adyen or Stripe. Try it free: upload last month's fee report and see what the higher rate cost you.

posts.name: Foundly SEO
posts.tagline: Get found on Google and named in AI answers
posts.description: Foundly SEO studies your site and your competitors, finds the searches you should own, and turns that into a content plan, ready-to-publish articles and clear fixes for your site structure. The goal is simple: rank on Google and get cited when people ask AI tools about your space. Run it yourself from $99 a month, or hand it to a dedicated Foundly strategist from $1,000 a month.

posts.name: Glot
posts.tagline: Real-time conversation translation
posts.description: We believe in what we can become together, when we truly understand one another. Glot is a real-time conversation translation app: two people who speak different languages talk naturally, and each reads and hears the other in their own language. It works three ways. Talk is one phone between two people. Duo is the same conversation on every phone in the room. Meet is a video meeting where everyone follows in their own language.

posts.name: hexazone.app
posts.tagline: Like Carcassonne but with hexagons
posts.description: Free alternative to Carcassonne. Triangles, squares or hexagon tiles. Additional game modes and expansions.

posts.name: VaprixAI
posts.tagline: Cybersecurity LLM & Autonomous Penetration Testing Platform
posts.description: Vaprix AI — Autonomous Cyber Security LLM and multi-agent VAPT platform. Zero false positives, deterministic verification, and automated AST code remediation.

posts.name: Simple Photo
posts.tagline: Turn a messy camera roll into a gallery worth sharing
posts.description: Go from a messy camera roll to a beautiful gallery of your best photos, ready to share in a couple of minutes. AI does the sorting: it picks the strong shots, hides poor ones and near-duplicates, and groups the rest into sections for you to review and rearrange. Galleries hold photos and videos, load super fast, and look good on phone, tablet and desktop. You decide who sees each one: share it publicly, by unlisted link, or as an invite-only private gallery.

posts.name: Rabotka Business
posts.tagline: Complete recruitment software
posts.description: Recruitment software (ATS) for companies and organisations in Africa: job posting, CV analysis, applicant tracking, interviews and team hiring.

posts.name: Rafeq
posts.tagline: Clear help for life in Saudi Arabia
posts.description: Rafeq helps residents and foreign workers in Saudi Arabia understand supported procedures in English, Arabic, Bengali, Urdu, and Hindi. Ask by text or voice and get clear, step-by-step guidance grounded in verified sources not guesses.

posts.name: MahjCan
posts.tagline: American Mah Jongg online, built for my mom
posts.description: MahjCan is American Mah Jongg and Canasta online, made for the people who actually play it. Big tiles, the full Charleston, no clock, and a table for your weekly group with reminders and season standings. Plays this year's League hands with your own printed card. Free daily puzzle and an at-the-table scorekeeper. 30 days free.

posts.name: Bagel²
posts.tagline: One app that runs your (small) business
posts.description: Think of Bagel² as a personal finance app for your small business. Bagel² keeps an eye on how your business is doing, takes care of your day-to-day work, and looks for ways to save you money. Connect the apps you already use: POS, accounting, inventory, staffing, and delivery. Bagel² automatically creates recipes, matches receipts to purchases, and tracks inventory and costs. No manual entry, no onboarding. Just connect and go.

posts.name: Store Designer by Obsess AI
posts.tagline: Ask for a Shopify store change, see it on your pages first
posts.description: Store Designer is an AI designer for Shopify stores. Ask for a change in your own words. It reads your store, then draws three directions on your real pages, at phone and computer width, with your own products and photos. Pick one and it goes into your theme as a block you place. Nothing changes until you press, and every change has its own undo. Big jobs, like a holiday launch, become one plan. $0 a month: you pay only for the AI work you use.

posts.name: Pictowalk
posts.tagline: Step inside any picture. A live walk, built on Genie 4
posts.description: Upload one picture of a place: an old family photo, a painting, a kid's drawing, a yard design. Pictowalk turns it into a live world you steer for 20 seconds with the keyboard or touch, with sound. Turn around and see what the picture never showed, then keep the video. Built on Google's new Genie 4 world model. $9 a walk with one free redo. No account needed.

posts.name: Stat Space
posts.tagline: The menu bar monitor for people who build things
posts.description: A native Apple Silicon menu bar monitor that idles under 0.3% CPU. CPU, GPU, memory, network, disk and sensors with 30 days of history, plus the answers devs need: what's on :3000 and who started it, what your AI agent left running, how much of your Claude Code limit is left, and why your Mac won't sleep. Per-app volume, 12 menu bar looks and a Mac health report. Free forever, no account. Pro is one-time.

posts.name: Awesome Homebrew Games
posts.tagline: Curated homebrew games for your old hardware
posts.description: Finding games for old hardware means digging through forums and wikis. Awesome Homebrew Games puts the useful places in one reviewed directory. Browse 70 places across 21 platforms, filter by machine, and use llms.txt with AI assistants.

posts.name: QR Wild
posts.tagline: One QR code for reviews, bookings, menus, and more
posts.description: Give customers an easy next step from your counter, table, or business card. QR Wild uses AI to help local businesses build a mobile page with links to Google reviews, booking, menus, and social profiles. Print a branded QR code, update the page while the code stays active, and see daily visits through your QR link. Build and preview free without an account. Ongoing hosting is paid.

posts.name: nope: stop impulse buying
posts.tagline: Pause impulse buys, track spending and build no-buy streaks
posts.description: nope helps you pause before an impulse purchase and keep track of what you spend. Check a potential buy, scan receipts into an expense journal, track subscriptions and build no-buy streaks. Your journal syncs through private iCloud across iPhone and iPad. Pro includes 25 AI receipt scans per month, with on-device receipt reading and manual entry also available. Start with a 7-day free trial.

posts.name: Quspo
posts.tagline: Live and online quiz games for groups of people
posts.description: Make a quiz in minutes and host it live on a big screen or completely online! Players join from their phone with a PIN, a nickname and a character: no app, no account.

posts.name: Ideogram 4.6
posts.tagline: Ideogram’s most precise editing model, with exact color
posts.description: Ideogram 4.6 is Ideogram’s new image generation and editing model for precise, multi-turn edits, with native output up to 4K. Per Ideogram, usable-result rates rose from 4.5 on exact color (46% to 83%) and character consistency (69% to 85%), with less pixel drift outside your edits. It supports masked Precise Edit and up to five reference images. It ranks first on Rapidata’s multi-step edit leaderboard. API prices start at $0.008 per image.

posts.name: AI Training Data Provenance Checker
posts.tagline: Which AI training datasets you cannot account for
posts.description: Paste the list of datasets behind your AI models, the list and never the data. Every dataset checked for origin, terms, personal and special category data, who labelled it, its version and declared potential overlap between train and test, each finding with the clause behind it. Eight lines free.
